assets.prompt: Create one polished widescreen 3:2 conceptual editorial cover for a software engineer's portfolio project called Document-to-Markdown VLM. Use case: stylized-concept. Depict a sculptural stack of ivory document sheets with abstract page layouts transforming through a translucent jade optical prism into neat structured text blocks. Dark forest-green background, ivory, lime and muted jade accents, soft studio light, tactile paper and frosted glass, refined technical editorial art. Spacious clean composition and a calm premium feeling, strong central silhouette readable at 400px wide. No words, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no UI, no watermark. This is conceptual artwork, not a screenshot or actual model output. Leave lower 15 percent quiet for a caption added by the website.

Use case: stylized-concept. Generate one polished widescreen 3:2 conceptual editorial illustration for a software engineering portfolio project, BERT Customer Feedback Classifier. A cluster of tactile ivory speech-bubble tiles with abstract embossed text lines flows toward three orderly translucent glass trays in soft jade, amber and muted coral, suggesting positive, neutral and negative sentiment. Dark forest-green studio background; refined lime accents matching a premium green editorial portfolio, gentle cinematic light and pleasing depth. Strong centered composition legible as a small web card, leave lower 15 percent quiet. No actual letters, words, numbers, logos, labels, interface or watermark. This is conceptual artwork, not a screenshot, not a chart of model results.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished widescreen 3:2 conceptual editorial illustration for a portfolio project implementing a Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model. Show six sculptural square glass tiles sweeping through space from left to right: chaotic ivory and jade particle noise gradually resolves into the same simple smooth abstract face sculpture, entirely stylized and non-photorealistic. Dark forest-green background, ivory, muted jade and lime details, soft premium studio lighting, gentle depth, restrained scientific editorial aesthetic. Composition legible at small web-card sizes, leave lower 15 percent calm. No text, numbers, graphs, logos, watermark or software interface. Clearly an illustration of the denoising idea, never actual training results.
